patronOf.en-US: The Mass of the day begins

prayerExcerpt.en-US: To You I lift up my soul: in You, O my God, I trust; let me not be put to shame.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: A Vós elevo a minha alma. Ó meu Deus, confio em Vós: não permitireis que fique confundido.

meta.basis: Having kissed the altar the priest goes to the epistle corner, 'ubi stans versus Altare, et producens a fronte ad pectus signum crucis, incipit intelligibili voce Introitum Missae' (Ritus servandus IV.2); when he signs himself the left hand is laid below the breast (III.5). The Introit is a proper: the Ordo has only `&introitus`, so the excerpt is the Missal's first Introit, Ad te levavi.
